verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents a GraphQL Storefront API for fully headless builds and a first-party frontend framework (Catalyst/Next.js) plus Stencil for hosted themes, giving developers multiple documented paths to a custom headless storefront (bigcommerce-docs-1, -2, -7, -18, -25). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the GraphQL API/Catalyst experience and no recent community confirmation countering an older complaint about API throttling (bigcommerce-comm-4).
